title: Make the GMCP operations and mastery tests pass on Unix: negotiate before closing the Unix-socket adapter
goal: On Linux x86_64, gmcp_req_203_007_06_operations, gmcp_req_203_011_06_operations and gmcp_vc_203_011_mastery failed on main d5599073e with 'unix socket: negotiation failed: ConnectionClosed("initialize request")'. Their Unix-only branch probes server/discover on a Unix-domain socket and closes it without the initialize handshake, then requires the served session to end as Closed; the in-process branch beside it handshakes first. The branch is compiled out on Windows, where these tests were written and recorded. Add the handshake at the three sites and re-record the VC-203 requirement and mastery evidence on the committed tree, so the v0.21.68 tests gate can pass (CEO direction 2026-11-15: fix the gmcp tests and cut the core release).
limitations: Verified on Linux x86_64 only; the changed lines are inside cfg(unix) blocks and do not compile on Windows.

tests/gmcp_requirements.rs and .agents/gmcp/evidence were inside ANTIGRAVITYS2's live claim T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-98 (board item 835); done on the CEO's direct instruction from a host whose Git proxy refuses board posts, so the owner could not be asked first.
